name: Maksim Soltan
statement: Maksim Soltan engineers execution-grade knowledge bases for agentic systems: assumptions are explicit, contradictions are preserved, provenance is attached, temporal validity is modeled, and outputs are made verifiable so tasks can be executed correctly on the first pass.

contact.preferred_use: Professional inquiries, technical collaboration, and knowledge-system design.

method.name: Execution-grade knowledge engineering
method.objective: Convert fragmented, conflicting, or time-sensitive information into a knowledge package an agent can execute and verify.
